sourceNote: MSLDC (Maharashtra State Load Despatch Centre) Monthly Curtailment Reports — MEASURED daily wind+solar curtailment with operator cause codes, parsed from the published mr10_MMYYYY.pdf series. 453 published days: solar 30.55 GWh + wind 2.73 GWh, annualised to 26.8 GWh/yr. Latest published day: 2026-06-30. NOT a live feed — reports publish monthly, lag 1–2 months and skip months entirely (2025-03, 2025-12, 2026-01 and 2026-07 were unpublished as at 2026-08-03), so the annualisation spans the published subset rather than a complete year. Flat 24/7 profile: the source gives daily energy only, so no intraday shape is claimed.
